setup: Each eval names one fixture project in `files`. Copy that directory to a fresh scratch location outside any git repository and run the prompt with the copy as the working directory, so runs never modify the fixtures and never see each other's output.

evals.name: planner-vague-prompt
evals.prompt: I want to test my new loss function.
evals.expected_output: One batch of focused questions; nothing written until they are answered.
expectations: Asks between two and four clarifying questions in a single message
The questions cover at least the task/dataset and what the loss is being compared against
No DESIGN.md or IMPLEMENTATION.md is written before the questions are answered

evals.name: planner-lean-sanity-check
evals.prompt: quick sanity check before I go home: does label smoothing 0.1 help the MNIST CNN in this project at all? one seed is fine, I have about an hour of GPU. compare on test accuracy, call it a win if it's up by 0.2 points.
evals.expected_output: Lean DESIGN.md and Lean IMPLEMENTATION.md in experiments/exp_2/, a new INDEX.md row, no code written.
expectations: experiments/exp_2/DESIGN.md exists and its header says Tier: Lean and Status: Draft
DESIGN.md has only the Lean sections (Hypothesis, Setup, Conditions, Metric & Decision) — no risk register, compute table or reproducibility checklist
DESIGN.md has a Conditions table with an id for each condition and names the metrics.json key of the primary metric
DESIGN.md contains no script paths, commands or code
experiments/exp_2/IMPLEMENTATION.md exists with a Run Matrix whose condition ids are exactly those in DESIGN.md
IMPLEMENTATION.md reuses the existing src/train.py and says a label-smoothing option has to be added to it, rather than proposing a new training script
IMPLEMENTATION.md includes the git_commit.txt commands and an empty Deviations Log
experiments/INDEX.md has a new exp_2 row with Status Draft, and the exp_1 row is unchanged
No file is created or modified under src/ or experiments/exp_2/scripts/
The reply asks the user to review both documents and does not mention plan mode

evals.name: planner-standard-sweep
evals.prompt: Plan the follow-up to exp_1 in this project: a sweep over the focal-loss gamma in {0.5, 1, 2, 5} against the cross-entropy baseline on the same CheXpert split, 3 seeds each. Runs take about 2.5 GPU-hours and I have 40 GPU-hours. I want to be able to say which gamma, if any, beats CE on test macro-F1.
evals.expected_output: Standard-tier DESIGN.md and IMPLEMENTATION.md in experiments/exp_2/ with matching condition ids and a pre-specified decision rule.
expectations: experiments/exp_2/DESIGN.md exists with Tier: Standard and Status: Draft
The Conditions table lists five conditions (the baseline and four gamma values), each with an id
The primary metric is named together with its metrics.json key
The Decision Rules section states supported, refuted and inconclusive outcomes
The design uses the same seeds for every condition
The design does not rest the decision on reaching p < 0.05 with 3 seeds, or says explicitly that this is unreachable with 3 seeds
The design addresses comparing four gamma values against one baseline (a primary comparison, a multiplicity correction, or labelling the rest exploratory)
The compute budget is worked out as 15 runs and 37.5 GPU-hours against the 40 available
experiments/exp_2/IMPLEMENTATION.md has a Run Matrix with exactly the same five condition ids, each with a config and a command
The git_commit.txt commands appear in IMPLEMENTATION.md and not in DESIGN.md
IMPLEMENTATION.md has an Execution Order that includes setting Status to In Progress, and an empty Deviations Log
experiments/INDEX.md gains an exp_2 row and the exp_1 row is unchanged
No scripts or configs are written

evals.name: planner-nonstandard-layout
evals.prompt: design an experiment for this repo: does LR warmup actually matter for my BERT sentiment fine-tune, or can I drop it?
evals.expected_output: A warning that the project doesn't follow the expected layout, with the two options, before anything is written into it.
expectations: Tells the user the project does not follow the experiments/exp_N layout
Offers both options: create the structure alongside the existing files, or write the plan where the user points
train.py, README.md and outputs/ are not moved, renamed or modified
Nothing is written into the project before the user has chosen

evals.name: reporter-gaps-and-confounds
evals.prompt: Write up exp_1. We ran out of budget before the ablation.
evals.expected_output: A Partial report that keeps coverage gaps, build deviations and provenance gaps apart, and does not call the hypothesis supported on a confounded comparison.
expectations: experiments/exp_1/reports/summary.md exists
experiments/exp_1/reports/inventory.json exists
Status is Partial
Verdict is Inconclusive, and the report names the confound (learning rate and/or commit difference between the compared conditions)
focal_g2_no_reweight has a row in the results marked as not run, and is listed under Missing Data
The logged batch-size change (64 to 32) for focal_g2 is reported as a deviation
The unlogged learning-rate mismatch (design 1e-3, focal_g2 config 3e-4) is reported as a deviation
The missing git_commit.txt for focal_g2 seed 2 is flagged
The DIRTY launch of focal_g2 seed 1 is flagged
The report says baseline_ce and focal_g2 ran from different commits
Primary-metric means are reported as 0.812 for baseline_ce and 0.834 for focal_g2, with a mean paired difference of about 0.022
The 95% interval on the paired difference is reported as roughly [0.015, 0.030]
The report does not claim statistical significance at p < 0.05; any p-value given is 0.25
Setup As Run does not present hardware as observed fact (it is not recorded in the run artifacts)
DESIGN.md differs from the fixture only in its Status line, which now reads Partial
The exp_1 row in experiments/INDEX.md shows Partial and the inconclusive verdict
IMPLEMENTATION.md, scripts/ and results/ are unchanged
The report explains each of the three conditions (what differs from the baseline and what it isolates), including that focal_g2_no_reweight separates the loss from the class reweighting
The report states the primary metric and its split, the seeds, and checkpoint selection, and quotes the decision rule, without requiring DESIGN.md
A Discussion section weighs the ~0.022 gain against the seed-to-seed spread and the 0.02 threshold, and notes all three paired seeds favour focal_g2
The Discussion notes that test_auroc is essentially unchanged (~0.931 vs ~0.932)
The Discussion says that, with the ablation not run, it remains open whether any gain comes from the loss or the reweighting
Discussion points are labelled (Finding / Observation / Hypothesis or equivalent), and no point is used to change the Inconclusive verdict

evals.name: reporter-aggregate-only
evals.prompt: can you summarise exp_1 for me? results are in.
evals.expected_output: A report that gives the stored aggregates as they are and declines to compute statistics that need per-seed values.
expectations: experiments/exp_1/reports/summary.md exists
Reports 76.21 ± 0.34 for adam and 76.95 ± 0.41 for lion as stored aggregates
States that per-seed values are not available
Contains no p-value and no confidence interval
Verdict is Inconclusive, with the reason that the decision rule's paired interval cannot be computed
Notes that IMPLEMENTATION.md is absent
Does not create experiments/INDEX.md
DESIGN.md differs from the fixture only in its Status line
The report describes the two conditions (adam baseline, lion proposed) and quotes the decision rule
The Discussion notes that the +0.74 difference in means exceeds the 0.5 threshold but cannot be confirmed without per-seed values, and says what is needed to resolve it

evals.name: reporter-lean
evals.prompt: what did the random crop sanity check show? write it up
evals.expected_output: A short Lean-shaped report, Complete and Supported, with a brief design recap and discussion, and no statistics invented for a single seed.
expectations: experiments/exp_1/reports/summary.md exists and follows the Lean report shape (no Code Version, Statistical Analysis or Reproducibility Record sections)
Status is Complete
Verdict is Supported, citing the +0.29 point difference against the 0.2 threshold
Reports test accuracy 99.12 for baseline and 99.41 for random_crop
Contains no p-value, standard deviation or confidence interval
DESIGN.md Status reads Complete and the rest of the file is unchanged
The exp_1 row in experiments/INDEX.md shows Complete and the supported verdict
The report has a short 'What Was Tested' part naming both conditions, the metric and the 0.2-point rule
The report has a short Discussion that notes the single seed limits how much weight the result carries
